property_summary: For any admissible deposit/withdraw/re-deposit amounts, withdrawing via Collect leaves the recorded balance at exactly prior-minus-withdrawn (a re-entrant Put during Collect is rejected by the lock); the mutant accepts the re-entrant Put and the recorded balance grows by the re-deposited amount.
change_summary: Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from Put so it no longer toggles the reentrancy lock, changing observable revert behavior when Put is invoked while the lock is held (e.g., via the fallback during a reentrant call).
